verdict.rationale: Penpot documents several programmatic surfaces: an API reachable with access tokens, a plugin API offering 'extensive access to objects and properties', outbound webhooks, and an official MCP server where design is 'expressed as code' so agents can read and interact with files. However, nothing claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec to verify coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity claim, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec showing coverage of UI features (components, prototyping, tokens, export), and independent hands-on confirmation of agent-driven full workflows.
